content: Vatano kov muno vatano mamun aya unanui

content.text: Kove ngkov irati vatano are pirati ponae beto vatano mamune
awa ananyao raiji,
muno ponae tavondi vatano wo ayao kakai rave awa unanui raiji,
muno ponae tuna vatano wo Amisye aura tantunawi matavoni.
Yara apa bekere mamo ananyao AMISY,
muno siman naman po ananyao AMISY
obo ratantona tutir.
Indati anakere kotar po raijare mamo ama ine raen,
raurata inyo moto nte no mana tuga
ama wao mayone ramu,
arono anamuke ama muki nande, weamo man dave.
Yara vatano mamune usasye,
onawamo maurata kapume rai,
ovare damawisyamo nsaonto ti rakanive.
Maisyare omaiti, onawamo usayae kakai no AMISY amun,
arono Po mangke rapatimu,
weye ayao kakai no mai ti usisa vatano kove
mai jewen.
Weye vatano kove nawamo AMISY Po mansayaranande,
yara vatano mamune nawamo wo unanuijo kakai raronto kobe.

footnotes.text: ,4,6 vatano mamun wenawamo vatano wonae Amisye Ai muno Apa ananyao rai muno ananyao rui vayave rai.

AMISY: Ayao Ibrani mo YHWH ratoe, bacave taiso maisy: ‘‘Yahweh.’’ Omamo Amisye taune Apa tam dave mije, ama ine mare ‘‘RISY irati RISY.’’ Tame so tavonamo ama ine mare ‘‘Risyamo sasye ramu nai unumeso ntoa nuge nuganui,’’ raura tavona ‘‘RISYAMO no pitawabe.’’
,6 vatano kove onawamo vatano ubeta Amisye Apa ananyao rai.
